CustomField.description: Per-section override of Lead duplicate-match resolution, read by Form_Submission_Convert_Setup (getPageSection branch, falling back to the Form Template's value). When the Lead Matching Rules return more than one match, true updates the most confident match instead of creating a new Lead during conversion.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the Lead matching rules find several possible matches during conversion, turn this on to update the most confident match rather than create a new Lead. This setting applies to just this section and otherwise inherits the Form Template's setting.
CustomField.label: Update Most Confident (Lead)
